title: Trump Doesn’t Want to Bomb Mexico, US Ambassador Says. He Calls for Recognizing the Bilateral Relationship
author: SinEmbargo Staff
content:
_This article by SinEmbargo Staff originally appeared in the[October 28, 2026
edition of SinEmbargo](https://www.sinembargo.mx/4895253/trump-no-quiere-
bombardear-mexico-dice-embajador-pide-reconocer-relacion-bilateral/), an
independent Mexican digital news outlet._

**Mexico City, October 28 (SinEmbargo).-** The **United States (US)
Ambassador** to **Mexico** , **Ronald Johnson** , stated this Wednesday that
the government headed by [**Donald
Trump**](https://www.sinembargo.mx/tag/donald-trump/) has no intention of
**bombing** Mexican territory by designating the **drug cartels** as
**terrorist organizations**. He also stressed that there should be no fear in
recognizing that both countries are **good partners**.

The [**US**](https://www.sinembargo.mx/tag/estados-unidos/) **diplomat** spoke
about the **bilateral relationship** on **security** during his participation
in the Milken Institute Global Investors Symposium, held at a hotel in
**Mexico City** (**CDMX**).

In his remarks, [Johnson](https://x.com/USAmbMex) explained that by
designating organized crime groups, such as the Jalisco New Generation Cartel
(CJNG) and the Sinaloa Cartel, among others, as terrorist organizations, the
Trump administration does not intend to launch bomb attacks on Mexican
territory, but rather it is a measure that seeks to track them internationally
and apply financial sanctions against them.

> "The purpose was to be able to employ other mechanisms, such as financial
> tools, economic sanctions, measures against support for terrorism to address
> the network in its entirety, since the cartels do not operate only in
> Mexico, they are present in Europe, Asia and South America. They even extend
> into the United States. We wanted to apply legal tools to confront this
> problem," he said.

![US Ambassador Ronald Johnson](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/10/02-ronald-johnson-partners.jpg)Ambassador Ronald
Johnson asked not to be afraid to recognize that Mexico and the US are good
partners. Photo: Galo Cañas, Cuartoscuro

The Ambassador also acknowledged that cooperation between Mexico and the
United States on security is currently at one of its best moments, mentioning
that "we are in a better situation than at any other time in my life; however,
there is still much room to keep making progress."

## Ambassador Asks Not to Be Afraid to Recognize the Good Relationship Between
Mexico and the US

As part of his message, Ronald Johnson asked not to be afraid to recognize
that Mexico and the United States are good partners since, in his opinion,
there are times when some prefer not to express that a good bilateral
relationship exists.

> Let us not be afraid to say that we are partners, that we have common
> interests and that we are working together. I do not intend to point at
> either side, but sometimes there is a certain reluctance to recognize it. It
> would be a great help if we simply accepted this partnership and saw
> everything we can achieve as North America, because we have it all. We have
> everything others want; it is here.
>
> Ronald Johnson, US Ambassador to Mexico

On this subject, the US diplomat mentioned that China would be "very happy" if
"Mexico fell into chaos, instability or insecurity, especially on the southern
border of the United States."

![US Ambassador Ronald Johnson](https://mexicosolidarity.com/wp-
content/uploads/2026/10/03-ronald-johnson-china.jpg)Ronald Johnson claimed
that China only seeks to extract resources from Mexico and take advantage of
its proximity to the US. Photo: Mario Jasso, Cuartoscuro
